chapters.title: A quiet evening
chapters.caption: Race Course Road in Little India, Singapore. The evening of 8 December 2013. Shophouses line the street and people walk home. The layout here is approximate.
chapters.source: estimated: scene of an ordinary evening, not a recorded event

chapters.title: A worker leaves a bus
chapters.caption: A private bus stops by the bus stop and a worker steps off. This is a typical scene, not a recorded one. The details are approximate.

chapters.title: The accident
chapters.caption: At about 21:21 a private bus hit a pedestrian on Race Course Road, near Tekka Lane. The pedestrian died. Positions here are approximate.

chapters.title: The first call
chapters.caption: At 21:23 the police received the first call. It reported a traffic disruption. It did not mention any violence.

chapters.title: People gather
chapters.caption: From about 21:31 to 21:38 the first police and emergency vehicles arrived. The crowd grew to about 100 people. The figures here are representative.

chapters.title: SCDF arrives
chapters.caption: At 21:39 the first SCDF vehicle arrived. It was a Red Rhino. The scene shows an ambulance as a stand-in. At 21:56 a paramedic pronounced the pedestrian dead.

chapters.title: Tension
chapters.caption: At 21:45 the crowd reached about 400. Later reports say 300. The Special Operations Command was activated. The scene shows 60 representative figures.

chapters.title: Police arrive
chapters.caption: In all, over 300 officers were dispatched that night. The scene shows a small group of them. Their positions are approximate.

chapters.title: Leaving the bus
chapters.caption: At 22:08 the bus driver and the timekeeper left the bus under police shield protection. The crowd attacked.

chapters.title: Vehicles overturned and burnt
chapters.caption: From 22:20 to 22:40 rioters flipped six vehicles and set four on fire. The scene shows only a few of them.

chapters.title: Special Operations Command
chapters.caption: At 22:50 the Special Operations Command arrived. Many rioters had surrendered and the crowd had become smaller. The officers shown are representative.

chapters.title: The crowd disperses
chapters.caption: By 23:30 all the rioters had dispersed from Race Course Road and the streets nearby.

chapters.title: The next morning
chapters.caption: In all, 62 people were hurt: 37 police officers, 12 SCDF officers, 5 Certis officers and 8 civilians. Race Course Road fully reopened at 06:45.

chapters.title: Committee of Inquiry
chapters.caption: A Committee of Inquiry was appointed on 13 December 2013. It reported on 27 June 2014. It ruled out racial and labour issues as causes.

captions.text: Race Course Road in Little India, Singapore. The evening of 8 December 2013. Shophouses line the street and people walk home. The layout here is approximate.

At about 21:21 a private bus hit a pedestrian on Race Course Road, near Tekka Lane. The pedestrian died. Positions here are approximate.
At 21:23 the police received the first call. It reported a traffic disruption. It did not mention any violence.
From about 21:31 to 21:38 the first police and emergency vehicles arrived. The crowd grew to about 100 people. The figures here are representative.
At 21:39 the first SCDF vehicle arrived. It was a Red Rhino. The scene shows an ambulance as a stand-in. At 21:56 a paramedic pronounced the pedestrian dead.
At 21:45 the crowd reached about 400. Later reports say 300. The Special Operations Command was activated. The scene shows 60 representative figures.
In all, over 300 officers were dispatched that night. The scene shows a small group of them. Their positions are approximate.
At 22:08 the bus driver and the timekeeper left the bus under police shield protection. The crowd attacked.
From 22:20 to 22:40 rioters flipped six vehicles and set four on fire. The scene shows only a few of them.
At 22:50 the Special Operations Command arrived. Many rioters had surrendered and the crowd had become smaller. The officers shown are representative.
By 23:30 all the rioters had dispersed from Race Course Road and the streets nearby.
In all, 62 people were hurt: 37 police officers, 12 SCDF officers, 5 Certis officers and 8 civilians. Race Course Road fully reopened at 06:45.
A Committee of Inquiry was appointed on 13 December 2013. It reported on 27 June 2014. It ruled out racial and labour issues as causes.
